correctness.rationale: For n>=4, pairwise intersecting 2-subsets are either a common-star family or an exceptional triple forming a ground-set triangle. The star-simplex union U has only pairwise point intersections and its equivariant integral cycle module is ker(∂2: wedge2 Z^n->Z^n)=wedge2 V_n. Exceptional oriented triangles yield the relative lattice wedge3 Z^n, and the connecting map is exactly the alternating contraction ∂3. Split exactness of the augmented exterior simplex chain complex over Z identifies ker ∂3=wedge3 V_n and ∂4 images of oriented four-ground-label octahedral spheres; ker ∂4 is generated by alternating five-label boundaries. Four-subset classes with label 1 are an actual integral basis, and coordinate symmetry preserves primitivity. Any smaller-than-six-vertex 2-cycle in a flag complex is removable by link filling; a hypothetical 5-vertex survivor must be a full simplex and has zero H2. Thus six supports are sharp. The determinant identity yields the rational hook character. Independently reconstructed exact integer ∂3∂4=0 and ∂4∂5=0 and matrix ranks C(n-1,3) for n=4..10, not used as a uniform theorem.
